intro.en:
I'm Yijie Lin, a Ph.D. student in the Multimedia and Secure Networking Laboratory, Department of Information Engineering and Computer Science, College of Information and Electrical Engineering, Feng Chia University. My advisor is Professor Chin-Chen Chang (IEEE Life Fellow and member of Academia Europaea). My research focuses on data hiding, information security, image processing, and artificial intelligence.

As of November 2026, I have authored 19 papers that have been accepted or published, including 15 as first or corresponding author. My work has appeared in IEEE JIOT, IEEE JSTARS, Signal Processing, and JISA, among other journals. I have been a regular reviewer for several leading international journals, including IEEE TIFS, IEEE TASLPRO, IPM, ESWA, and INS.
intro.zh_Hans:
我是林翼洁，目前在逢甲大学资讯电机学院资讯工程系多媒体暨网络安全实验室攻读博士学位，师从张真诚教授（IEEE Life Fellow、欧洲科学院院士）。我的研究方向包括数据隐藏、信息安全、图像处理和人工智能。

截至2026年11月，已录用或发表论文19篇，其中15篇为第一作者或通讯作者论文。研究成果发表于 IEEE JIOT、IEEE JSTARS、Signal Processing、JISA 等期刊。长期担任 IEEE TIFS、IEEE TASLPRO、IPM、ESWA、INS 等多个高水平国际期刊审稿人。
